text:
In 2022, 23 countries recorded higher spirits consumption per adult than Russia: Saint Lucia, Latvia, Estonia, Lithuania, Slovakia, Bulgaria, North Korea, Barbados, Dominica, Antigua and Barbuda, Belarus, Thailand, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Hungary, Mauritius, Poland, the United States, Seychelles, the Philippines, Laos, Grenada, Czechia and Mongolia. Russia’s figure was 3.42 litres of pure alcohol from spirits per person aged 15+ annually; this comparison uses [WHO data compiled by Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/spirits-consumption-per-person) and excludes unrecorded consumption.

CONFIDENCE: 96
